text:
emma.yang: Heads-up — we need to plan rebuilds and a canary rollout for the OpenSSL/glibc fixes that landed in upstream packages. Thinking slice-based rollout to limit blast radius. Who's available to own scheduling and canary monitoring? :eyes:
kevin.patel: I can drive scheduling. Propose slices by dependency tier: runtime/base images first, infra images (sidecars/k8s helpers) second, app images third. Prioritize images used by Dedicated nodes and VPC customers.
olivia.gray: +1 on slices. Concern: several of our musl-based images (Alpine) show runtime test failures for a handful of C-extensions. We need a depgraph check before promoting any musl rebuilds.
raj.singh: I'll run a dependency impact scan today. I'll produce a matrix: image -> glibc/musl -> linked libs -> failing tests. If we find ABI breaks we'll hold musl images and only rebuild glibc (Ubuntu) ones first.
sre-bot: CI job queued: `ci/image-rebuild-scan --since=7d --cves=openssl,glibc` (job id: 2026-IR-341). Output will attach to the thread when done.
sec-team: From a compliance perspective we need: signed manifests, KMS-backed attestation, and immutable promotion steps logged to audit. Who will own the signer key rotation window?
kevin.patel: For signing we should use the existing KMS key in prod account, create a separate signer principal for the image-promotion service, and require 2-person approval for key usage in the first 48h of rollout. Audit logs + push events will go to our retention bucket.
emma.yang: Good. Can we make the canary window 24h per slice with health checks tied to: error-rate, p99 latency (inference hosts), and cache hit ratio? If any metric regresses >20% we auto-roll back.
kevin.patel: Agreed. Canary schedule: slice-0 (critical runtime) => 4 instances across two regions, 24h. slice-1 => 8 instances, 24h. slice-2 => staggered over 3 days. Rollback command (manual/automated):
```
# rollback to previous digest
registry.promote --from=stable-previous --to=canary --policy=force
kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-runtime --namespace=prod
```
We'll add an automated monitor that execs the rollback when thresholds crossed.
olivia.gray: Also add a compatibility smoke to canary: run a small set of model-inference/unit tests that exercise native libs and serialization paths. If musl binary fails, we fail the canary immediately.
raj.singh: Slice mapping I'm proposing (short):
- slice-0: base runtime images (redwood/runtime, runtime-libc-shims)
- slice-1: infra helpers (sidecars, exporters, init-containers)
- slice-2: product app images (control plane, console)
I'll post the full list in the incident ticket.
sec-team: RBAC note: create `image-signer` role in registry with push/promote but no delete. Create KMS IAM role `image-signer-kms` with granular useKey permissions and attach an auditor role that gets CloudTrail logs. We'll want a signed provenance attestation attached to every promoted digest.
kevin.patel: CI gating snippet (will add to `image-ci`):
```
jobs:
  canary-promote:
    needs: [build, scan]
    runs-on: runners/prod
    steps:
      - name: Verify scan
        run: test -f scan/report.json && jq .high scan/report.json
      - name: Sign image
        run: cosign sign --key ksm://projects/prod/keys/image-signer $IMAGE
      - name: Promote to canary
        run: registry.promote --image $IMAGE --target canary
```
We need a `cosign` wrapper with KMS integration; I'll open a small PR. :shipit:
emma.yang: Next steps / owners:
- kevin.patel: schedule slices, drive canary infra + monitor thresholds (owner)
- raj.singh: dependency impact matrix and full image list (owner)
- olivia.gray: compatibility smoke and test harness for musl/glibc (owner)
- sec-team: KMS key setup + signer RBAC + audit retention (owner)
- emma.yang: coordinate external comms to customers and approve rollback policy (owner)
Please ack in thread when you have bandwidth or if you want to swap tasks.
kevin.patel: ack, starting scheduling doc now -> will link ticket when CI job completes.
raj.singh: ack, running scans now. Expect matrix in ~3h.
olivia.gray: ack, will stand up smoke job and post results.
sec-team: ack, creating KMS key and IAM roles; will share ARN and audit plan.
sre-bot: CI job complete: `ci/image-rebuild-scan` found 12 images with direct openssl/glibc linkage; report attached to ticket IR-341.
emma.yang: Thanks team — let's keep communications tight while the slices roll. If we hit an unexpected regression we pause promotion for downstream slices immediately. :thumbsup:
